title: Summarize scoped customer order and unlinked receipt amounts by customer and currency
description: A sales user previews known order and separate unlinked-receipt amount evidence for the current authorized page. Add only finite none/customerCurrency amount-summary modes to the existing dynamic receipt reconciliation preview. Recheck current-user sales-order menu and SalespersonDataScopeService scope on every request; reject invalid modes before source reads and retain existing HTTP audit. Group by customer ID and original currency; keep order-side linked/uncovered evidence distinct from unlinked receipts, split receipt evidence status, preserve unknown null totals and truncation. Do not infer payment allocation, receivable balance, or cross-currency totals. Development only: no arbitrary SQL, direct model database access, schema/migrations, production SQL or real database execution, writes, secrets/.env changes, deployment, or real-browser acceptance. Verify focused unit tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Preview accepts only none/customerCurrency amount modes, rejects invalid modes before source reads, and reuses the ERP-164 authorized bounded page and HTTP audit.

Current-page order and unlinked-receipt amount groups remain separate by customer and original currency; pending/historical receipt evidence remains distinct, unknown contributors yield null totals with known/unknown counts, and truncation is explicit.
Unit tests cover denied users, invalid modes, currencies, null amounts, receipt states, empty/paged results and no writes; document the amount-evidence boundary and pass safe Release build/test.
